fullDescription: A standalone timeline COMPONENT for a marketing or product page: A compact order or process tracker with done, live and pending states. Each row draws its own connector, so a row can be inserted without recomputing anything. Done rows carry a check and a green connector, the live row carries a pulsing marker, pending rows stay muted. A summary count and a status pill sit above and below. Built in the light shadcn register (ground #FAFAFA, cards #FFFFFF, hairline #E4E4E7, one indigo #4F46E5, Inter throughout) so it drops into an existing design system without a restyle. No images, no libraries and no build step; avatars are drawn from initials. About 5KB, responsive to 390px, and it degrades to something genuinely readable under prefers-reduced-motion rather than freezing.

structured.summary: A self-contained timeline component. A compact order or process tracker with done, live and pending states. Each row draws its own connector, so a row can be inserted without recomputing anything. Done rows carry a check and a green connector, the live row carries a pulsing marker, pending rows stay muted. A summary count and a status pill sit above and below. The page contains the component and nothing else, so it can be lifted straight into a section.

style.description: Light shadcn section register: a near-white ground, white cards, 1px hairline borders, 12 to 16px radii, one indigo accent, and Inter at 400 to 700. No shadows beyond a 1px lift, no gradients used as decoration, no photography.
style.prompt: Ground #FAFAFA, card #FFFFFF, ink #09090B, muted #71717A, border #E4E4E7, accent #4F46E5. Inter 400 for body, 600 for names and titles, 700 for the heading. Radii 12 to 16px, borders 1px, and a single 0 1px 2px rgba(9,9,11,.04) lift on cards. Draw avatars from initials on a coloured disc rather than loading images, so the component has no asset dependency. Ease everything with cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1).

prompts.prompt: Each row draws its own connector, so a row can be inserted without recomputing anything. Done rows carry a check and a green connector, the live row carries a pulsing marker, pending rows stay muted. A summary count and a status pill sit above and below.
Reflow rather than shrink: horizontal rails become vertical rails, multi-column grids drop columns progressively, and nothing is allowed to overflow the viewport at 390px.
Under prefers-reduced-motion, remove the motion mechanic entirely and show a plain readable equivalent. A magnifying rail or a rotating ring frozen mid-animation is unusable; a list is not.
